description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmailSubscriptionDao class within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup procedures, test methods for listing and editing email subscriptions, and references to various OrangeHRM modules and testing utilities.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing EmailSubscriptionDao methods related to email subscription management within OrangeHRM's admin module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by instantiating the EmailSubscriptionDao and populating test data from YAML fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEmailSubscriptionList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of email subscriptions, asserting the count and the type of returned objects.

methods.name: testEditEmailSubscriptionList
methods.description: Tests editing and saving an email subscription, verifying the change and returned object properties.
